description: brrpolice: status, bans applied, how peers were judged, and how fast it polls. The collapsed row holds API latency, errors, database and pruning.

panels.title: Since last poll
panels.description: Time since the last successful poll of qBittorrent. Over a minute means it is stuck or cannot connect.

panels.title: Errors
panels.description: API errors, failed bans, failed prunes and metrics errors in the selected range. Should be 0.

targets.expr: (sum(increase(brrpolice_qbittorrent_api_errors_total{job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance"}[$__range])) or vector(0)) + (sum(increase(brrpolice_bans_total{job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance",result="failed"}[$__range])) or vector(0)) + (sum(increase(brrpolice_prune_runs_total{job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance",result="failure"}[$__range])) or vector(0)) + (sum(increase(brrpolice_metrics_encode_errors_total{job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance"}[$__range])) or vector(0))

panels.title: Active bans
panels.description: Peers banned right now. Bans expire; repeat offenders get longer ones.

panels.title: Bans applied
panels.description: New bans in the selected range.

panels.title: Slow peer checks
panels.description: Share of checks where a peer received under the target rate (64 KiB/s) without progressing.

panels.title: Torrents policed
panels.description: Completed torrents with connected leechers. 0 means nothing to judge.

panels.title: Bans per hour
panels.description: New bans (up, by reason) and expired bans (down). When they balance, the ban count holds steady.

panels.title: Time to ban
panels.description: How long banned peers misbehaved before the ban.

panels.title: Peer health
panels.description: Share of peer scores each hour: healthy, watch, or over the ban threshold. Set the thresholds to match your config.

panels.title: Peer check outcomes
panels.description: Every check ends in one decision. Exempt: allowlisted, new, nearly done or banned. Cooldown and in flight: ban already handled.

panels.title: Poll loop time
panels.description: Typical poll (line) against the hourly prune (dots), which delays polling when it runs past the dashed poll interval.

panels.title: Runtime · API latency, errors, database & pruning
qBittorrent API latency
panels.description: qBittorrent API response time: typical and slowest 1 %.

panels.title: Errors per hour
panels.description: Errors each hour by kind: qBittorrent API, failed bans, failed prunes and metrics encoding. Expect none.

panels.title: Database
panels.description: SQLite size and stored peer sessions (retention window, not live peers).

panels.title: Rows pruned per hour
panels.description: Rows removed by the hourly prune, by table.
